Today's best deals
 The Amazon Black Friday sale is here. After several days of build-up, the retailer's full end-of-year deals event is officially underway — and I've got all of the best deals right here for you. There are some huge discounts up for grabs on smart home tech, TVs, Kindles, appliances, headphones, toys, essentials, and so much more.
 The best Amazon UK Black Friday deals 
 (Image credit: Future) 
 As you would expect, the event is heavy on Amazon devices, with some of the largest price cuts available on Ring doorbells, Blink cameras, and even a record-low on the brand-new Kindle .
 Other highlights include big savings on a Nintendo Switch 2 bundle, best-ever prices on top-rated headphones from Sony and Shokz, and cheap appliances from brands including Shark , Dyson , Ninja, and De'Longhi.
 Now that the full sale has started, it might take me some time to dig through it all to uncover all of the best deals, but that's what I'll be doing right here, with live updates over the next couple of weeks from myself and the TechRadar team.
 Amazon Black Friday sale — quick links 
 Amazon Prime : get a 30-day free trial 
 Amazon Devices : up to 67% off Ring & Blink 
 Amazon Haul : 30% off 
 Appliances : up to 40% off Ninja & De'Longhi

I'm mildly obsessed with this Festive Gingerbread house, which hinges open to reveal Santa's bedroom and office (he's a surprisingly minimalist fellow). Right now there's 20% off in the early Black Friday sales, and it'll arrive in plenty of time for Christmas.
